documents: Personal statement or statement of purpose

applicationFee.note: US citizens/permanent residents pay $120. International applicants cannot receive central waivers. Request through Payment Options at least two weeks ahead; typical processing is one to two weeks.

english.toefl: 80 before January 21, 2026; 5.0 on or after that date
english.note: IELTS Academic, including online, accepted. Two-year validity at deadline. No Duolingo, IELTS General/UKVI, TOEFL Home Edition or MyBest. Qualifying English-only degree education may exempt testing. Where WHED lists English alongside other instructional languages, direct institutional proof and program approval may allow an application exemption; admission requirements may still apply.

requirements.note: Bachelor’s and normally GPA 3.0; exceptions possible. Only one UCSF graduate program application except joint Berkeley Bioengineering. Foreign records require evaluation after admission: CCB specifies WES. Central start-of-first-term timing is earlier than CCB’s midpoint wording.

funding.note: Tuition, fees and living stipend throughout the PhD while in good standing. Published stipend is historical, not confirmed for Fall 2027.

international.note: International admissions are limited by funding restrictions and highly competitive.
